body:
## Why
The reap step skips any job that `jobAlive()` says is alive — which since the classifier fix includes `blocked` (permission-waiting). Correct for a RUNNING task, but a job whose task is already closed/done can never legitimately be waiting: kb #17 and kb #21 sat as blocked zombies for 15 hours after their tasks merged.

## What
In the tick's reap step: a kb job whose task number is not on the open board (closed issue) or whose task is done/archived gets `claude stop` regardless of blocked/waiting state — only `working`/`busy` jobs of RUNNING tasks are protected. Cover with a fake-gh + stubbed-jobs test.
title: Reap background agents whose task is closed, even when their state is blocked
